name: TM7 Extra-Mature Cheddar Cheese Scones
ingredients: 125 g extra-mature Cheddar cheese, cut into 2-3 cm pieces
130-150 g whole milk, cold, plus a little extra for brushing

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 220°C conventional / 200°C fan. Line a baking tray with baking paper.

Put 125 g extra-mature Cheddar into the mixing bowl and grate 5 sec / speed 7. Transfer about 25 g of the grated Cheddar to a small bowl and set aside for topping, leaving the remaining cheese in the mixing bowl.

Add 225 g self-raising flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp English mustard powder, 1/4 tsp fine sea salt, 1/4 tsp freshly ground black pepper, 1 pinch cayenne pepper and 50 g cold unsalted butter. Mix 8 sec / speed 6. The mixture should resemble coarse breadcrumbs with the cheese evenly distributed.

Add 130 g cold whole milk and mix 8 sec / speed 4. Check the dough: it should be soft and slightly tacky, not dry. If there are dry patches, add 10 g more milk and mix 3 sec / speed 4. Add a final 10 g milk only if still needed and mix 3 sec / speed 4. Do not overmix.
Turn the dough onto a very lightly floured work surface. Bring it together gently with your hands without kneading. Pat out to 2.5-3 cm thick.

Cut out 8 scones with a 6 cm round cutter, pressing straight down without twisting. Gently bring the scraps together and cut the remaining scones. Arrange on the prepared baking tray with about 1-2 cm between them.
Lightly brush only the tops of the scones with a little milk, taking care not to let it run down the sides. Sprinkle with the reserved 25 g grated Cheddar.
Bake at 200°C fan for 12-15 minutes, until well risen, deeply golden and the Cheddar topping is bubbling.
Leave on the tray for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack. Serve warm, ideally split and spread with salted butter.
